changelog: ✦ MT5 OCR Direct Vision & File Picker Fix: Perbaikan aktivasi pemilih screenshot Android & fallback engine Gemini Vision langsung di HP.
✦ MT5 Screenshot Scan (Gemini Vision OCR): Impor otomatis riwayat trading MT5 ke Jurnal Trading lewat screenshot hasil trade.
✦ Global Scroll Guard: Mencegah konflik gesture pull-to-refresh Android saat scroll chart & dialog overlay.
✦ Guided Practice 100 Kasus: Penambahan 100 soal latihan interaktif ICT across 8 pilar materi komprehensif.
